merged_yaml:
---
workflow:
  rules:
  - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "push" && $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" && $CI_COMMIT_REF_PROTECTED
      == "true"
  - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "web" && $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" && $CI_COMMIT_REF_PROTECTED
      == "true"
  - when: never
stages:
- ".pre"
- test
- build
- verify
- public_data
- ".post"
variables:
  UV_CACHE_DIR: "$CI_PROJECT_DIR/.cache/uv"
  GIT_STRATEGY: clone
  GIT_DEPTH: '0'
  RUN_PUBLIC_RETAIL: '0'
default:
  tags:
  - data-process-local-shell
  interruptible: true
  timeout: 30m
  retry: 0
  before_script:
  - sh .ci/bootstrap.sh
  cache:
    key:
      files:
      - uv.lock
      prefix: uv-python-3.11.17
    paths:
    - ".cache/uv/"
core_test:
  stage: test
  script:
  - ".venv/bin/python .ci/check_config.py"
  - ".venv/bin/python -m pytest -m 'not macos' --junitxml=.ci-reports/junit.xml -v"
  - ".venv/bin/python -I -m data_process.smoke --output .ci-reports/source-smoke.json"
  artifacts:
    when: always
    access: developer
    expire_in: 7 days
    reports:
      junit:
      - ".ci-reports/junit.xml"
    paths:
    - ".ci-reports/junit.xml"
    - ".ci-reports/source-smoke.json"
build_wheel:
  stage: build
  needs:
  - job: core_test
    artifacts: false
  script:
  - ".venv/bin/python .ci/build_wheel.py"
  artifacts:
    access: developer
    expire_in: 14 days
    paths:
    - dist/*.whl
    - dist/manifest.json
    - dist/runtime-requirements.txt
installed_wheel:
  stage: verify
  needs:
  - job: build_wheel
    artifacts: true
  script:
  - sh .ci/installed_smoke.sh
  artifacts:
    when: always
    access: developer
    expire_in: 7 days
    paths:
    - ".ci-reports/installed-smoke.json"
public_retail_manual:
  stage: public_data
  timeout: 40m
  needs:
  - job: installed_wheel
    artifacts: false
  rules:
  - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "web" && $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH &&
      $RUN_PUBLIC_RETAIL == "1"
    when: manual
    allow_failure: true
  - when: never
  script:
  - sh .ci/public_replay.sh
  after_script:
  - rm -rf .ci-state/public-retail .ci-state/public-retail-backup .ci-state/public-result.json
    .ci-state/public-download.json .ci-state/public-error.log
  artifacts:
    when: always
    access: developer
    expire_in: 3 days
    paths:
    - ".ci-reports/public-status.json"
